scope: Revision-pinned single-file unified hunks through edit_lines, existing approvals/batches/undo and explicit successful-history elision.

source_seal.selection: All Python application/test/script/benchmark files, root and nested project locks/manifests plus existing config/CI inputs; same selection as external-editor-20261028.json.

contracts.mode: exactly one of edits or patch; path/read_id required; single existing file, including empty
contracts.matching: exact old/new coordinates and counts; exact body/whitespace/EOF; no offset, trim or fuzzy matching
contracts.newlines: preserve existing context/deletion bytes and BOM; added terminated lines follow the unique file EOL, LF when absent; mixed EOL additions require explicit edits; no-newline marker explicit
contracts.authorization: existing full-diff literal-True approval, read-only/tool/privacy/policy/cancel checks, stable source recheck and private backup
contracts.batch: same existing distinct-file preflight and per-file approval; invalid later hunk/file yields no initial writes; partial later refusal remains explicit
contracts.context: only older uniquely settled, approved changed same-path edits are eligible; history/results/recent tail remain, markers cannot execute

sprig-line-patch-full-wsl-20261029.finding: Existing Schema assertion still required edits; updated it to require path/read_id and check both alternative payload types.

remote_ci: pending; all commits [skip ci]; no Actions before 2026-11-01 Asia/Singapore; verify account restriction and prior gate before resuming
limits: Headless Enter TUI and local Windows/WSL do not prove remote native CI, macOS or the full Python matrix.
Standard-diff random oracle and fixed-reply protocol chains do not prove model coding gains, token savings or completion of the overall capability goal.
Patch accepts numbered hunks for one existing path; file creation/move/deletion use their existing tools. Mixed-EOL terminated additions require explicit edits.
